newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: SAVINGS BANK TO BOOST CAPITAL BY 20 MLN LITAS.
newsitem.headline: SAVINGS BANK TO BOOST CAPITAL BY 20 MLN LITAS.

text.p: The shareholder meetings of Savings Bank on Friday approved a capital increase of 20 million litas to 80 million litas after government representatives blocked a capital rise of 30 million litas, the bank said.
A split of the face value of the shares to 10 litas from 100 litas and the reduction of the board members to five from seven was also approved at the meeting, a bank spokesman said.
The spokesman had earlier said the bank would propose a capital increase of 30 million litas. But representatives of the state's 74 percent stake vetoed the suggestion.
